{{DISPLAYTITLE:''Sunday Driver''}}
[[File:Sunday_Driver.jpg|thumb|right|200px]]
'''''Sunday Driver''''' is a [[2005]] documentary film, directed by Carol Strong, that chronicles The Majestics, California's oldest black lowrider car club, which was originally founded in Compton. With up close and candid interviews that were recorded while hanging out with the club, the movie delivers an upfront look at the low riding lifestyle of Southern California.

The documentary is currently available as part of [[Rockstar Games|Rockstar Games']] special edition of ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.
